feed.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Prof. Edil has demonstrated a strong capability in curating technical documentation, particularly within the Bitcoin development community. His involvement during the Vinteum Mining Deep Dive was instrumental in refining the Stratum V2 specification, ensuring clarity and precision throughout the document. Colleagues who have worked alongside him highlight the productive outcomes resulting from his guidance and editorial oversight.
The positive feedback regarding Prof. Edil's contributions underlines the value he brings to collaborative technical projects, especially those requiring meticulous attention to detail in written materials. His expertise supports the ongoing efforts to maintain high standards in protocol documentation and developer communications.
